summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Hi Anzy production website. All backend APIs working perfectly (13/13 tests passed). Frontend loads without errors across all pages. Navigation, content flows (Work, Network, Insights), and contact form submission all functional. Minor UI issue identified with contact form dropdown selects not closing after selection, but form submission works with required fields.
